title: Diploma In Health And Social Care Management (Level 5)
description: Comprehensive training designed to enhance leadership and operational expertise in health and social care management.
longDescription: The Level 5 Diploma in Health and Social Care Management develops advanced knowledge for managing teams, ensuring safety, and promoting wellbeing in care settings. Emphasis is placed on collaborative working practices, professional supervision, and safeguarding vulnerable individuals. Learners gain practical insight into research methods and how to apply evidence-based strategies. The programme prepares individuals for mid to senior-level roles across health and social care organisations. Focused modules align with real-world standards and regulatory frameworks in the sector.
courseDetails: The course includes in-depth modules such as Working in Partnership, which explores collaborative inter-agency care. Safeguarding and Protection focuses on risk identification and protective measures for vulnerable populations. Team Management and Professional Supervision strengthen leadership capabilities within care environments. Additionally, Health Education and Research Methods build essential skills for promoting public health and applying empirical knowledge in decision-making. This diploma equips learners with practical and strategic competencies to manage safeguarding, team leadership, and wellness promotion. Ideal for progressing in the dynamic health and social care sector.

entry: For entry into Level 5 Diploma in Health and Social Care Management, learners must possess the following:
* Relevant/Local Board of Examination Result in your Country, which must include at least 5 'C' Grades in English and 4 other subjects.
* Mock Examination Result can also be accepted for initial Conditional Admission, pending the release of the Board of Examination Result. (This is assessed on a case by case basis)
* Learner must be 18 years or older at the start of the Course.
* Mature Learners (21 years or older) with work experience in supervisory, leadership or management roles. (This is assessed on a case by case basis).
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
workshops: Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak our course advisors on this subject.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.

outcomes: Demonstrate effective strategies for working in partnership with stakeholders to enhance service delivery in health and social care settings.
Analyse the principles and procedures of safeguarding to protect vulnerable individuals from abuse, harm, and exploitation.
Design and implement health education initiatives that promote well-being and address public health concerns.
Apply leadership and team management techniques to improve performance, communication, and collaboration within care teams.
Conduct professional supervision sessions that support staff development and ensure compliance with sector standards.
Evaluate legal and ethical frameworks related to protection and safeguarding in health and social care.
Develop research proposals and apply research methodologies to inform practice and improve outcomes in care environments.
Critically assess the impact of multi-agency collaboration on the quality and effectiveness of care services.
